result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but there are a few visible layout issues around clipped horizontal content and the fixed bottom navigation overlapping feed content.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the restaurant feed. The second card in the “Popular right now” section is partially hidden behind the bottom nav area, which can make content feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: A category chip is partially visible and cut off on the far right after “Healthy,” showing only the edge of the next pill with no readable label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal category carousel spacing or add a fade/scroll indicator so partially visible items look intentional rather than clipped.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel clips the third restaurant card on the right side, including the restaurant name and image area.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have consistent sizing and right padding, or use a fade/peek treatment to clearly indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The restaurant name “Tokumaru Ramei” appears likely misspelled or truncated, as it may be intended to read “Tokumaru Ramen.”
issues.suggestion: Verify the restaurant name and correct the text if it is a typo.
